signals.title: AUD/CHF — G10 Bilateral Theme + Geopolitical Friction
signals.text: The 2.071% G10 strength spread between AUD and CHF creates a dominant bilateral theme for the open as IRGC threats to close the Strait of Hormuz escalate geopolitical risk. AUD COT LF long +49.7k (75.2% long, pctl 94) reflects a crowded long that faces liquidation risk if trade friction intensifies, despite its +1.301% 1W performance lead. CHF remains the G10 laggard (1W avg -0.770%) but attracts haven bids under the current bear flattener regime and restrictive NOK/USD yield spreads. Trade bias: Bearish AUD/CHF on geopolitical escalation; AUD's 435bp OIS carry advantage is secondary to crowded-long unwind risk. Catalyst: Sydney open and IRGC headline developments. Risk: De-escalation of Strait of Hormuz tensions restores the AUD carry bid.

signals.title: USD/JPY — Jackson Hole Hawkishness + Yield Divergence
signals.text: Fed Chair Warsh's hawkish shift at Jackson Hole boosts the USD toward the 160.04 Friday close as the US 10Y yield rises to 4.72%. JPY COT net short -73.6k (lev_net) reinforces the upside bias, while the 266bp SOFR-TONA carry spread sustains long USD/JPY positioning. BOJ Board Member Tamura attending Jackson Hole instead of Governor Ueda reduces the immediate risk of a hawkish counter-signal from Tokyo. Trade bias: Bullish USD/JPY; hawkish Warsh rhetoric and the 175bp US-JGB yield gap favor the dollar. Catalyst: Tokyo open and follow-through from Warsh speech. Risk: Direct BOJ intervention if 161.00 is breached or a sharp rise in JGB yields.

signals.title: USD/CAD — Bullish Momentum + ESI Support
signals.text: USD/CAD closed Friday at 1.3902, supported by a 139bp SOFR-CORRA carry advantage and a bearish flattener US yield curve regime. CAD COT LF net short -89.8k (pctl 3, z -2.07) reflects extreme bearishness, yet CAD's positive ESI (+20.8) suggests domestic data remains resilient. The upcoming 9 September BoC meeting determines if Governor Macklem pivots to protect growth against the Fed's hawkish stance. Trade bias: Bullish USD/CAD; extreme CAD shorts are supported by the widening US-CA 10Y spread (-97bp). Catalyst: next BoC meeting (mkt: 100% hold priced) on 9 September. Risk: BoC delivers a hawkish hold surprise, triggering a squeeze of the pctl 3 CAD shorts.

signals.title: AUD/USD — Retail Sentiment Extreme vs COT Alignment
signals.text: Retail sentiment on AUD/USD is 89% short, providing a contrarian bullish signal that conflicts with the crowded LF net long +49.7k. The 71bp OIS carry advantage for AUD (AONIA 4.35% vs SOFR 3.64%) supports the long-term bid, but immediate technical resistance remains as the pair closed at 0.7164. Neutral AUD ESI (+1.4) provides little fundamental impetus to break the current Jackson Hole-driven USD strength. Trade bias: Neutral AUD/USD; retail and institutional positioning are diametrically opposed. Catalyst: next RBA meeting (mkt: 100% hold priced) on 29 September. Risk: Further geopolitical tension in the Strait of Hormuz triggers risk-off AUD selling.
